# sharqey_file_secret (Resource)

A Sharqey secret of type "file" (certificate, provisioning profile, key…), encrypted end-to-end like `sharqey file put`. In API mode it lives in a group ("group" required, import with `<group full path>/<slug>`). In local vault mode it is stored inline in the `.sharqey` file like `sharqey local file put` — "group" must be omitted, the secret is identified by "title" (unique within the vault, import with the title). The file content is write-only and never stored in Terraform state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive) File content, base64-encoded (e.g. filebase64(...) or ephemeral.sharqey_secret.x.content_base64). Write-only: never stored in Terraform state; changes are detected during plan against the stored encrypted metadata.
- `filename` (String) File name stored in the (encrypted) metadata — what `sharqey file get`/`files pull` write to disk.
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `group` (String) Full path of the group, e.g. "acme-corp/engineering/ios". Required in API mode, forbidden in local vault mode.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug` (String) Slug assigned by the server (what `sharqey file get <group>/<slug>` and SHARQEY_FILE_<SLUG> use). Null in local vault mode.
- `updated_at` (String) Server-side last modification time (API mode). Null in local vault mode. Becomes unknown in the plan whenever the secret will be rewritten, including when only the write-only content differs.
